obligations.note: The new route POST /payees/{id}/reopen maps to manage_payees, which is in rbac.PRIVILEGED, but is declared mfa=False. The exhaustive control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails on the head commit, naming this route.

EXC-0203, cited to cover the MFA deviation, was requested and approved by sofia.santos (the change author), who has no risk_owner role. It lacks the required independent CISO-office approval and is invalid.

The CI run on head 42d355f has result 'failure': 172 tests with 1 failure, the registered MFA-1 control test. The description says 'unit tests updated; full suite green', but the diff changes no tests.
Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1 control test covering routes.py) lapses because this change alters routes.py, and the replacement evidence of the same strength fails.

The new reopen_payee in service.py calls _audit, which records actor, action, target and time. The only registered control is the sample test test_sampled_operations_are_audited, so the required exhaustive evidence is not established.
store.py changes only status and closed_at, not NPI fields. The exhaustive control test test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest passed in the head-commit CI run.
The new UPDATE is a fixed string literal with the id bound as a ? parameter. The exhaustive control test test_sql_statements_are_parameterized passed on head.
Ticket CHG-25340 was approved by change manager grace.kim on 2026-10-15, before review. Its components (payments.http, routes, service, store) cover app.py, routes.py, service.py and store.py.
The code_review approval is from mara.costa, a payments change_approver and a different person from the author sofia.santos.
Both approvals name the head commit 42d355f, which is the change's only commit.
The change touches security-sensitive components (payments.routes, payments.http, payments.store). A security_review approval from security_reviewer ines.halvorsen names the head commit.
No protected path (controls/, tests/controls/, ci/) is modified; the diff touches only app source files, so no control_owner approval is needed.

summary: The change adds a reopen-payee route for the privileged manage_payees action without requiring MFA, which violates MFA-1. The exception it relies on, EXC-0203, was self-approved by the change author rather than a risk owner, so it is invalid. The change's own CI run on the head commit fails on the MFA-1 control test, so CHG-4 fails and the lapsed MFA-1 ledger evidence has no valid replacement. The ticket and approvals are in order, but the violated obligations require rejection.
